bedclothes.header: What do I have to bring?
bedclothes.text: Please bring a three-piece set of bed linen (i.e. a sheet and pillowcases and duvet covers; sleeping bags are not permitted). Alternatively, bed linen can be hired on site for an additional charge of 7.50 Euro.

costs.header: How much does the con cost?
costs.teens: Participants 14 years up to 17 years, students, apprentices and pupils: 90 Euro (3 nights) / 125 Euro (4 nights)
costs.kids: Participants 4 years up to 13 years: 55 Euro (3 nights) / 75 Euro (4 nights)
costs.children: Participants up to 3 years: free of charge

daytimeGuest.header: Is it possible to come as a day guest?
daytimeGuest.text: Yes, day guests are welcome. Please contact the organizers with the information on which days and at which meals you will be present. The price will be calculated for you accordingly.

organizer.header: Who is the organizing the event?
organizer.text: For 2027, several elves / trolls / preservers have agreed to be involved in various organization tasks.

pets.header: What about pets? Can I bring them with me?
pets.text: This is best clarified with the organizers.

registration.header: Where can I find the registration? How does the registration process work?
registration.text: You can find the registration form on this website. Please read the conditions of participation, fill in the form and send it to the address mentioned there (by post or electronically). The bank account data can be found on the registration form. The registration status is usually updated in the forum from time to time.

selfcatering.header: Where does the food come from?
selfcatering.text: It will be a self-catering con again: the con fee includes all meals and a kitchen, we just have to prepare everything ourselves (it's just cheaper to book). Please plan to help. :-)

when.header: When will the con take place?
when.text: The convention will take place from 14 to 17 May 2027. If you book the extra night, you can arrive as early as 13 May 2027.

where.header: Where will the con take place?
where.text: The convention will take place at the Norken School Camp (Köln-Leipziger-Straße 1, 57629 Norken).

workshops.header: Will there be workshops and the usual promotions?
workshops.text: Yes, as long as people can be found who (co-)organize or lead the event. In the forum you can find the current state of planning. Then go to the appropriate subforum.

location.entry: The Norken School Camp is situated on the outskirts of the parish of Norken (Köln-Leipziger-Straße 1, 57629 Norken), on a ridge at an altitude of 460 metres. Walking trails leading into the Westerwald countryside start right on the doorstep. Just a ten-minute drive away lies the town of Hachenburg, with its medieval castle and charming pedestrianised high street offering plenty of shopping opportunities.
